play_modes.100: 25 rows per class, stratified across the whole pool
play_modes.1000: 250 rows per class, stratified across the whole pool

sources.name: Yahoo Answers 10 Categories for NLP
sources.attribution: Yahoo Answers 10 Categories for NLP, packaged by yassiracharki on Hugging Face.
sources.notes: The dataset card declares Apache-2.0. The rows are derived from Yahoo Answers user content, so upstream Yahoo terms may still apply. Labels are noisy and several rows were filtered by the topic anchors in the builder.

sources.name: AG News
sources.attribution: AG News, introduced by Xiang Zhang, Junbo Zhao and Yann LeCun (2015), packaged by fancyzhx on Hugging Face. Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/1509.01626
sources.notes: The Hugging Face dataset card declares license: unknown. These 1770 short news rows are included for educational use with attribution. Review the terms before commercial use, or rebuild without AG News if you need a single clear license.

license_summary.summary: Yahoo Answers rows are declared Apache-2.0 by the dataset card. AG News rows have no declared license.
license_summary.commercial_use: Review AG News terms before commercial use.
license_summary.redistribution: The canonical JSONL is committed with source attribution. If you republish it, keep this file and the source links with it.

caveats: Legal & Regulatory is keyword-filtered, not a gold label.
Yahoo Answers source labels are noisy.
Medical, Politics and Financial rows must match a topic anchor.
The dataset is for an educational lab, not for production moderation.

sampling.why: Taking the first N rows can pick one fold, one source or one class. The sampler orders each class by a stable hash and takes the first N per class.
sampling.holdout: Play samples include the full pool by default. Use --exclude-holdout for a clean benchmark batch.

checks: 8 folds x 1000 rows, 250 per class per fold
play mode 100 has exactly 25 rows per class
play mode 1000 has exactly 250 rows per class
sample selection is deterministic for the same seed and mode
